panels.title: Average Interest Rate by Loan Type

targets.rawSql: SELECT loan_type, avg_rate_min, avg_rate_max FROM v_interest_by_loan_type ORDER BY avg_rate_min

panels.title: Best Interest Rate per Loan Type (by Lender)

targets.rawSql: SELECT loan_type, MIN(interest_rate_min) AS best_rate, company_name FROM policies p JOIN lenders l ON l.id = p.lender_id WHERE p.is_active AND p.approval_status = 'approved' AND l.approval_status = 'approved' AND p.interest_rate_min IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loan_type, company_name ORDER BY loan_type, best_rate LIMIT 50

panels.title: Interest Rate Distribution (box plot by type)

targets.rawSql: SELECT loan_type, interest_rate_min FROM policies p JOIN lenders l ON l.id = p.lender_id WHERE p.is_active AND p.approval_status = 'approved' AND l.approval_status = 'approved' AND p.interest_rate_min IS NOT NULL ORDER BY loan_type

panels.title: PSU vs Private vs NBFC — Rate Comparison

targets.rawSql: SELECT company_type, ROUND(AVG(p.interest_rate_min)::numeric, 2) AS avg_min_rate FROM policies p JOIN lenders l ON l.id = p.lender_id WHERE p.is_active AND p.approval_status = 'approved' AND l.approval_status = 'approved' AND p.interest_rate_min IS NOT NULL GROUP BY company_type ORDER BY avg_min_rate
SELECT day AS time, searches FROM v_match_volume_daily ORDER BY day
